chart.description: Cache hit rate for instance and shards
chart.name: Cache hit rate
chart.programText:
A = data('cachehits*', filter=filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true') and filter('resource_type', 'Microsoft.Cache/Redis', 'microsoft.cache/redis') and (not filter('sf_metric', 'cachehits')), extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=5,rollup='rate').mean(by=['azure_resource_name', 'azure_resource_id']).above(0).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('cachemisses*', filter=filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true') and filter('resource_type', 'Microsoft.Cache/Redis', 'microsoft.cache/redis') and (not filter('sf_metric', 'cachemisses')), extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=5,rollup='rate').mean(by=['azure_resource_id', 'azure_resource_name']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = ((A) / (A+B) * 100).publish(label='C')

chart.description: Number of expired keys for an instance and shards
chart.name: Expired keys
chart.programText: A = data('expiredkeys*', filter=filter('resource_type', 'Microsoft.Cache/Redis', 'microsoft.cache/redis') and filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true') and (not filter('sf_metric', 'expiredkeys')), rollup='latest').mean(by=['sf_metric', 'azure_resource_name', 'azure_resource_id']).publish(label='A')

chart.description: Total # Of keys in an instance and shards

chart.description: Cache hit rate for instance and shards
chart.name: Cache hit rate trend

A = data('cachehits*', filter=filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true') and (not filter('sf_metric', 'cachehits')),rollup='rate').mean(by=['sf_metric', 'azure_resource_id', 'azure_resource_name']).above(0).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('cachemisses*', filter=filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true') and (not filter('sf_metric', 'cachemisses')),rollup='rate').mean(by=['azure_resource_name', 'azure_resource_id']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = ((A) / (A+B) * 100).publish(label='C')

chart.programText: B = data('usedmemoryRss*', filter=filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true') and (not filter('sf_metric', 'usedmemoryRss')), extrapolation='last_value').publish(label='B')

chart.description: Amount of data written to each of the shards

chart.name: Used memory
chart.programText: B = data('usedmemory*', filter=filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true') and (not filter('sf_metric', 'usedmemory')) and (not filter('sf_metric', 'usedmemoryRss*')) and filter('resource_type', 'Microsoft.Cache/Redis', 'microsoft.cache/redis')).publish(label='B')

chart.description: When RSS >> used, a large difference means there is memory fragmentation. When used >> RSS, it means part of redis memory has been swapped off by the operating system: expect some significant latencies
chart.name: Memory fragmentation ratio
chart.programText:
A = data('usedmemory', filter=filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true')).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('usedmemoryRss', filter=filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true')).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = ((B+1)/(A+1)).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Used memory per cache
chart.programText: A = data('usedmemory', filter=filter('resource_type', 'Microsoft.Cache/Redis', 'microsoft.cache/redis') and filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true') and (not filter('sf_metric', 'usedmemoryRss*'))).mean(by=['azure_resource_name', 'azure_resource_id']).top(count=5).publish(label='A')

chart.name: Server load %
chart.programText: A = data('serverLoad', filter=filter('resource_type', 'Microsoft.Cache/Redis', 'microsoft.cache/redis') and filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true')).mean(by=['sf_metric', 'azure_resource_name', 'azure_resource_id']).top(count=5).publish(label='A')

chart.name: Total keys
chart.programText: A = data('totalkeys', filter=filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true')).sum().publish(label='A')

chart.description: Total number of caches including shards
chart.name: # Caches
chart.programText: A = data('usedmemory', filter('resource_type', 'Microsoft.Cache/Redis', 'microsoft.cache/redis') and filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true'), extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=-1).mean(by=['azure_resource_name', 'azure_resource_group_name', 'azure_region']).count().publish(label='A')

chart.name: Lowest cache hit rates
chart.programText:
A = data('cachehits', filter=filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true'), rollup='average', extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=5).mean(by=['azure_resource_name', 'azure_resource_id']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('cachemisses', filter=filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true'), rollup='average', extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=5).mean(by=['azure_resource_name', 'azure_resource_id']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = ((A) / (A+B) * 100).publish(label='C')
